items.title: ERROR_SERVICE_DISABLED Fix for Windows 10 & 11
items.description: To fix ERROR_SERVICE_DISABLED, enable the disabled service from an administrator Command Prompt. Run the sc config command to set Windows Update and BITS to automatic start, then use net start to launch them. Restart your PC afterward, and the update or feature that failed should run normally.
